text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Three metered wind farms W1 to W3; 53 Tuesday runs, kept half-hours, true days 1 to 10 (lead 24 to 240 hours). Lines: mean forecast q95 and q99 in each of 8 bins of the forecast median. Crosses: the observed 95th and 99th percentile of power in the same bin. Lines on the crosses mean calibrated.'
